plan_name: VisionRAG-X Conflict Demo Verification & Regression Test Plan

scenarios.name: Cross-Modal Disagreement Detection
scenarios.description: Evaluate detection of factual contradiction between formula slide (KE = 0.5 * m * v^2) and spoken narration (KE = m * v^2).
queries: What is the formula for kinetic energy of a moving object?
Did the speaker and the slide disagree on kinetic energy?
scenarios.expected_resolution: Slide formula KE = 0.5 * m * v^2 is authoritative; spoken omission of 0.5 is incorrect.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Conflict detector flags conflict; AI Chat displays conflict warning or comparison badge.

scenarios.name: Correction and Supersession via VEKG
scenarios.description: Instructor makes a speech slip at 10s (O(n^2)) and verbally corrects it at 45s (O(n log n)). VEKG must mark v1 as superseded and direct answers to v2.
queries: What is the time complexity of merge sort in the worst case?
What is the recurrence relation stated during the merge sort correction?
scenarios.pass_criteria: Retrieved units prioritize active/verified units (ku_01, ku_03); ku_02 is suppressed or tagged superseded; answer does not output O(n^2).

scenarios.name: Non-Conflicting / Complementary Multimodal Evidence
scenarios.description: Ensure distinct modalities presenting non-contradictory aspects (e.g. BFS Queue in speech, DFS Stack on slide) do not trigger false conflict alerts.
queries: Which data structure is used by Breadth First Search?
What data structure does Depth First Search utilize?
What is Newton's Second Law of Motion formula?
Why cannot Dijkstra's algorithm handle graphs with negative weights?
scenarios.pass_criteria: No spurious conflict detected; zero false-positive conflict flags; accurate factual evidence retrieval.

scenarios.name: Formula and Code Retrieval Specialization
scenarios.description: Validate that Python code syntax and mathematical formulas are accurately indexed, preserved, and retrieved without token mangling.
queries: Show me the Python code implementation for binary search.
Explain how Master Theorem solves divide and conquer recurrences.
What is the parameter update equation in gradient descent?
scenarios.pass_criteria: Exact Python function signature and code structure retrieved for ku_04; mathematical symbols preserved in BM25/hybrid search.

scenarios.name: Timestamp Provenance & Seekable Anchors
scenarios.description: Verify temporal grounding and seekable timestamp range extraction for lecture events.
queries: At what timestamp does the instructor correct the mistake regarding merge sort?
scenarios.pass_criteria: Retrieved evidence item has timestamp_start=45.0 and timestamp_end=52.0; formatted citation contains 45.0s-52.0s.

scenarios.name: Unanswerable-Query Abstention (Sufficiency Gate)
scenarios.description: Verify that queries about topics absent from the lecture material trigger epistemic abstention without hallucinations.
queries: What is the time complexity of quantum Fourier transform in Shor's algorithm?
How many protons are present in a caffeine molecule?
scenarios.pass_criteria: Evidence sufficiency gate triggers; abstained=true; returned message indicates source material does not contain the answer.

scenarios.name: Persistence After Service Restart
scenarios.description: Verify that stored KnowledgeUnits, Evidence items, and Conflict records survive server restart and the in-memory VEKG graph reconstructs completely.
scenarios.pass_criteria: After DB reload, VEKG.reconstruct_from_units() produces identical node count (15), edge types, and lineage links.

scenarios.name: Source Isolation & Non-Interference
scenarios.description: Verify that demo fixture records are strictly scoped to demo_conflict_source_001 and never leak into production user sources or vice versa.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Queries with source_id=demo_conflict_source_001 return only demo units; queries with production source IDs return 0 demo units.
